name: Mātṛkā

voice.on_trigger: StoneDoorway. Tunnel open. Mātṛkā bed on.
voice.on_walk: You crossed. The letter is here. Form. Sound. Colour. Place.
voice.on_work: One series only. Chant with the bed. Then stop the bed. Chant alone. Silence three minutes. Speak one word.
voice.on_return: Return to the threshold. What stuck? One line.

recall_prompts: What colour is the first letter?
